name: HyperZ & Family Graph Scope
purpose: Define the research graph that CryptoAID can use for historical/project questions without asserting unsupported relationships.
evidence_rules: Publicly verifiable evidence is required for public person or wallet attribution.
Social membership counts are not unique-person counts.
Project adjacency does not establish shared ownership or legal liability.
Private-group anonymous members are not catalogued.
Unresolved aliases must remain unresolved rather than being guessed.
